Frequently Asked Questions

Why hire a farmhouse interior designer in Rajokri?

Rajokri has many farmhouses used as homes and for events. A specialist plans large spaces so they feel warm, work for gatherings and stay easy to maintain.

Can a farmhouse be designed for weddings and events?

Yes. We plan lawns, outdoor lighting, guest areas, washrooms and service routes so events run smoothly while the main house stays private.

What style suits a Rajokri farmhouse?

Most clients like a mix of modern comfort and natural materials, with open living spaces that lead to lawns and verandas.

What does a farmhouse interior designer plan for maintenance?

Durable floors, washable fabrics, enough storage and easy access to services keep a large farmhouse simple to look after.
